{{Top}}
'''Priestess''' was a title. [[Elan]] was a priestess of the [[Yuuzhan Vong]]<ref name="Elan">''[[The New Jedi Order: Agents of Chaos I: Hero's Trial]]''</ref> and [[Darth Simi]] was a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] priestess.<ref name="Visions">''[[Star Wars Art: Visions]]''</ref>
